purpose: Teach: 迷わ/掴む/乗れる/はやく/はやり/思い出せ/逃げ出し/見落とし

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、迷わ、絶対、ず、絶対、ご注文、絶対、決めたよ
lines.en: Mom, I really, truly mean it — I'm not going to change my mind about this.
lines.style: Breathless with conviction, slightly rushed. Small chest puffed out. Earnest emphasis on "really" — he needs her to know he's serious. Ends with a little nod of certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの心、本気で、絶対、掴む、絶対、お父さんの日カード、絶対、作ってね
lines.en: Sho, make that Father's Day card with all your heart, okay?
lines.style: Warm and gentle but with intention underneath. Not a request — a soft assignment. The tone of someone guiding him toward something good without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、自転車、絶対、乗れる、絶対、ようになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned how to ride my bike without training wheels!
lines.style: Bright, uncontained pride. Sits a little taller saying it. Quick opening attack. Expects celebration — the joy is already there in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、はやく、絶対、お風呂入ってね
lines.en: Sho, take your bath now, please?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. No edge, but not negotiable either. The automatic warmth of a mother who's said this a hundred times and will say it a hundred more.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、はやり、絶対、のアニメ、絶対、見てもいい?本気で
lines.en: Mom, can I watch that anime everyone's talking about? Please?
lines.style: Hopeful tilt at the end. Quiet enough that he's testing the waters, not demanding. The small pause before "please" — he knows it's worth asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、お買い物リスト、本気で、絶対、思い出せ、絶対、ないわ
lines.en: Sho, I can't remember anything from the shopping list, honestly.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly rueful laugh underneath. Affectionate exasperation with herself. Quick and dry — she's not looking for sympathy, just admitting defeat to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お勉強、本気で、絶対、逃げ出し、絶対、たくなる時、絶対、ある
lines.en: Mom, sometimes I really want to run away from studying.
lines.style: Quiet honesty. Not complaining — confessing. He's trusting her with something real. Soft, a little vulnerable. Trailing off slightly, like he's surprised at himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お勉強、本気で、絶対、見落とし、絶対、ないでね
lines.en: Don't let yourself miss anything in your studying, okay?
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Clear-eyed concern. The words carry weight — she's not micromanaging, she's protecting. Ends steady and direct.
